name: Crumbled Orange-Ginger Tofu Rice Bowl with Tomato-Kale Salad

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup jasmine rice
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
1 orange
½ bunch kale
½ pint grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
Juice orange into the bowl with the ginger and garlic. Add oil, vinegar, soy sauce, and honey, then whisk to combine the marinade. Transfer ⅓ to another medium bowl and set aside for the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Crumble tofu with your fingers into the remaining bowl with the marinade. Stir to coat and set aside.
Peel, halve, and slice shallot crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the medium bowl reserved for the salad and stir to combine the dressing.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl, toss to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add tofu and marinade. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is golden, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice, salad, and tofu between bowls. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and enjoy!
